model: Smart Weather Desktop Clock (GeekMagic SmallTV / SmallTV-Ultra)
intro: FermFrame was tested on the yellow and white "Smart Weather Desktop Clock" from the first shop below. Other shops sell the same clock under GeekMagic SmallTV names - check the listing before you buy.
lookFor: "Smart Weather Desktop Clock" - yellow, white or black (the tested listing)
ESP8266 or ESP-12F chip, if the listing says which chip
avoid: SmallTV Pro (it has an ESP32 chip)
Crystal cube, UFO, transparent-screen or other GeekMagic shapes
